verdict.rationale: The SDK is a library published on GitHub that you run in your own process via the Runner class. It is provider-agnostic, supporting 100+ non-OpenAI LLMs, and its hosted tracing can be disabled, so the core agent loop can run on your own infrastructure. However, several features depend on OpenAI-managed services: the hosted tools (web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP) and the Traces dashboard. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, documented self-hosted alternatives to the OpenAI-managed tools and Traces dashboard, independent hands-on corroboration of fully self-hosted deployments.
